_about: The per-game data list the contract's game checks read (Sprint 17, s17-chk1; read by lib/contract-chai.mjs, used by lib/contract.mjs and lib/contract-s14.mjs). A game is checked the day it is listed: to join, add or fill its entry under games; a field left out means 'not yet' and that check passes it by. Shape: _fields below (each check's field: true, a word, or an object whose own stations and routes narrow the game's); stages: the stage kinds contract-91 judges, as regular expressions on the stage key; hosts: entries that are not games (the clinic) but share chai's help. Proof a game joined: node --test build/sandbox/contract-chai.test.mjs (a fake game added is checked).

_fields.stations: the station ids its flows play, as the flow names them (cook:<id>, cook:recipe:<id>, lab:cook/<id>, lab:cook/recipe-<id>); every check below reads these unless its own entry names stations
_fields.routes: (in a check's entry) only these flow routes: cook (cook:<id>), recipe (cook:recipe:<id>), lab (lab:cook/<id>), lab-recipe (lab:cook/recipe-<id>); default all four
_fields.help: contract-91 (help-comes): the stage kind (a key of stages) where the help comes when stuck; stage keys do not name the game, so every stage of that kind is judged once any listed entry names it
_fields.controlCalls: contract-78 (call-light) and CONTROL_CALLS: the calls that open a control step, the engine's words in lower case, no marks
_fields.slowAtGreen: contract-70: the turn-off call as the heat bar enters the green: its Lifecycle notes (slow: the call, down: a pan turned down), the line as said, how far past the green's edge is late
_fields.onceEach: contract-71: the things that go in once each: the Lifecycle note of an add and the notes' items, what they are in words
_fields.cardLight: contract-90: a new player at L1 sees the order card's next item lit after the first item: the Lifecycle note of an add and that first item
_fields.s14Taps: contract-44 (S14_TAPS): its light has no finger (chai's s14 light; a drag's hand is fine)
_fields.decoys: contract-37 (DECOY_STATIONS): exact (the rules' count by level) or atLeast (at least that many)
_fields.cardWritten: contract-35 (CHAI_ROW): its order card's item words stay written at L3-L4 (never dotted)
